title: Chapter 2 System Appearance
content:
Chapter 2 System Appearance

"Hahaha, hahaha, you have today too!" Zhong Yu was very relieved when he saw the end of the wolf. Lying on the tree trunk, he took a few breaths and looked down, only to find that there was an endless plain below, looking at an area of about tens of square kilometers.

Thinking back, the stream that Zhong Yu first passed through, it slowly flowed into the plain, irrigating the plain, making the grass around the plain so fertile that almost someone's waist was high.

Zhong Yu rested for a while, then slowly stood up and climbed up the cliff. It seemed that because of excessive blood loss, his body was a little weak, and his hands were constantly shaking.

He almost fell several times, but Zhong Yu persevered and escaped from the wolf's mouth. Would he still die in such a place? how is this possible! This firm belief flashed through his heart and made him climb up.

Zhong Yu was lying on the cliff, breathing the air fiercely. The flipping action just now almost exhausted his physical strength. He was seriously injured just now, and he exerted a lot of strength, so that Zhong Yu's life could be changed at any time. are likely to disappear.

Lying on the ground weakly, moving his fingers, he used all his strength. Zhong Yu had a faint premonition that his body was about to collapse. With the passage of vitality, Zhong Yu's consciousness was slowly blurring.

In his mind, a question came to mind, why am I here? I'm going to die, I'm so sorry!

It seems that I have crossed into another world. Before I start a glorious life, the flower of life will slowly wither. Sure enough, am I not the protagonist of the legend? I don't have the legendary arrogance. I'm still an old man with gold fingers. I'm still a waste. I'm a otaku who nobody cares about. No one will know when he dies. Besides his parents, who cares about his disappearance. Woolen cloth!

Destiny, I really like to make fun of people. I just thought I had a big opportunity in my life, but I changed such a joke to myself.

Just when Zhong Yu's consciousness was about to dissipate and he could no longer feel his body, suddenly, a "ding" sounded in his mind, which made his consciousness suddenly awake and his consciousness suddenly awake a lot.

"It is detected that the host's life is passing, and the system is being repaired. After the repair is completed, the imperial conquest system is started, loading, and loading is complete."

Hearing the sound coming from his ear, Zhong Yu felt a burst of surprise in his heart, and the desire for life slowly burned in his heart, what?

I remembered the sound of no one around me just now. Thinking of coming to this place inexplicably, Zhong Yu couldn't help but say, "Who? Is it God? If it is God, save me!"

The voice came out of Zhong Yu's ear again, like mechanization: "Don't be afraid, the host, I am the imperial conquest system, created by an unknown powerful existence, and because I heard your host's voice, I specially created me to assist the host. Conquer this other world."

The body slowly regained its strength, and the wounds on the body did not know why? Is it really God who is playing a joke on me? A happy joy appeared on Zhong Yu's face, which was a celebration of his near-death, and slowly calmed down his excitement.

It was a thrilling day, more exciting than my usual life. I almost survived several times, and I came to this inexplicable place again, as if it was a different world.

Zhong Yu was exhausted and could no longer think about so many questions. Thinking back to today's experience, he cried and laughed, not knowing how to express his feelings.

At the same time, I was still afraid for a while, why I was so careless and came to an unfamiliar place, as if it was still a primitive forest, and just walked in so carelessly.

As a result, when he encountered such a vicious beast, he almost lost his life, but luckily he did not die. Sure enough, is the vigilance of the otaku that bad? Be sure to be more vigilant in the future!

...

A few hours later, Zhong Yu hid in a tree more than ten meters high, and just lay down and rested in peace. He felt a little sense of security in his heart, and he relaxed to recover his strength, but he recalled the voice just now in his mind.

The imperial conquest system, an unknown powerful existence, a different world, Zhong Yu also recalled these voices, and there was no danger to his life. As a professional otaku, how did he not know that he had encountered the legendary time-travel?

My luck is not so bad. Am I the child of destiny in the legend, the beauties of another world, waiting for the embrace of the uncle, and the ants from the other world, obediently crawl at the feet of Uncle Zhong Yu!

"System, do you have your own thoughts and feelings?" Zhong Yu couldn't help but be a little scared when he thought of the systematic conspiracy theories when he read novels on the Internet!

"This system has no self-awareness, and can only act according to the set program, and will not harm the host, so the host does not need to be afraid!"

So, hearing the mechanized voice of the system, Zhong Yu felt a little reassured. Since this is the case, I have to think about what to do next. After thinking about it for a while, Zhong Yu said to the system.

"System, since you are assisting me in conquering another world, what role do you have! Is there anything I can exchange? Can you show it to me?"

"There are currently only two functions in this system, posting tasks and redemption."

"Release a task is to trigger a task when the host meets certain conditions, and my host can complete the task and get the system's task reward!"

The cold voice of the system paused for a while, as if it was giving Zhong Yu some time to slowly digest the previous words, and then continued.

"As for the exchange function, the host can provide luck points, and come to the system to exchange various materials or talents, so that you can quickly obtain the heritage that would normally take decades or even longer to accumulate!"

"For example, a weapon takes months or even years to build, and as long as the host provides sufficient luck points, it can be redeemed immediately, or a talent or army requires him for decades or decades. It takes time to learn and train to be able to use it, and as long as the host has enough luck points, he can immediately get a talent and army that can be used."

"When Zhong Yu heard this, he thought in his heart that this method is quite good. In the past, why were there so many aristocratic families in ancient times, it was not because they could cultivate talents to rule the world, have accumulated enough material heritage, and mastered the great powers necessary for a society. For some talents and materials, a country cannot maintain its operation without the existence of the gentry, which is why they have caused their glorious period, and can even influence the rise and fall of a dynasty.

"System, after hearing you say it for so long, I still don't know what luck points are. Can you tell me how to get them?"

"The luck point, as the name suggests, is about a person's luck, and if the host wants to get it, he only needs to deepen his influence in a world, so that he can extract the world and the luck of the people who are affected by him. Click on yourself!"

It turns out that this is the case. If this is the case, it seems impossible for me to live a peaceful life in this world, but why is there a feeling of anticipation and excitement in my heart?

Suddenly, I suddenly felt that I had missed something, something very important!

"System, you just said that there are only exchange and task functions at present, so do you mean that more functions will be developed in the future?"

"Yes, as long as the host continues to improve his ability and strength and provide enough luck points for the system, then the system can unlock more functions to help the host and survive better in this world, all of which need the host. s hard work!"

Hearing the last words of the system, Zhong Yu thought to himself that there are more functions, and he still has to work hard!

Newcomers and new books, seeking attention and recommendation.
